description: These regulations are called the Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020.
expected_value_or_format: Title as specified.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: The regulations prescribe labelling requirements of pre-packaged foods and display of essential information on premises where food is manufactured, processed, served and stored.
expected_value_or_format: Apply labelling/display provisions.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: The regulations came into force on publication in the Official Gazette; FBO compliance is after one year except Chapter 3, originally due by 1 January 2022; the source notes compliance w.e.f. 1 July 2022 by Direction dated 22 October 2021.
expected_value_or_format: General compliance w.e.f. 01-07-2022 as stated in Version VIII; Chapter 3 source history notes 01-01-2022 and later compliance direction.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Act": Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Act 34 of 2006).
expected_value_or_format: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (Act 34 of 2006).

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Assorted pack": Package/container containing multiple units of different food products intended/displayed for retail sale and complying with Regulation 4(8).
expected_value_or_format: Package/container containing multiple units of different food products intended/displayed for retail sale and complying with Regulation 4(8).

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Best before date": Date signifying end of stated storage period during which food remains fully marketable and retains specific qualities; after it may still be safe though quality may diminish, but shall not be sold if unsafe.
expected_value_or_format: Date signifying end of stated storage period during which food remains fully marketable and retains specific qualities; after it may still be safe though quality may diminish, but shall not be sold if unsafe.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Children or child": Person under 18 years as defined in the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015; applicability for specific food categories may be indicated in relevant regulation.
expected_value_or_format: Person under 18 years as defined in the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015; applicability for specific food categories may be indicated in relevant regulation.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Date of manufacture": Date on which food product becomes the product as described.
expected_value_or_format: Date on which food product becomes the product as described.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Date of packaging": Date on which food product is placed in the immediate container in which it will ultimately be sold.
expected_value_or_format: Date on which food product is placed in the immediate container in which it will ultimately be sold.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "e-commerce": Buying and selling of goods and services over digital and electronic network.
expected_value_or_format: Buying and selling of goods and services over digital and electronic network.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Foods for catering purposes": Foods for restaurants, canteens, schools, hospitals, QSRs, home delivery operators, caterers and similar institutions where food is offered for immediate consumption.
expected_value_or_format: Foods for restaurants, canteens, schools, hospitals, QSRs, home delivery operators, caterers and similar institutions where food is offered for immediate consumption.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Front of Pack": Part of package facing forward in the principal field of vision and typically first seen by consumer.
expected_value_or_format: Part of package facing forward in the principal field of vision and typically first seen by consumer.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Infant": Person not more than 12 months of age.
expected_value_or_format: Person not more than 12 months of age.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Labelling": Written, printed or graphic matter present on label, accompanying food or displayed near food.
expected_value_or_format: Written, printed or graphic matter present on label, accompanying food or displayed near food.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Lot/code/batch number": Identification mark using numeral/alphabet or combinations, including specified abbreviations, enabling traceability in manufacture and identification in distribution.
expected_value_or_format: Identification mark using numeral/alphabet or combinations, including specified abbreviations, enabling traceability in manufacture and identification in distribution.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Multi-unit package": Package containing two or more individually packaged/labelled units of same food commodity, with identical and/or different net quantity, intended/displayed for retail sale individually or as whole, complying with Regulation 4(8).
expected_value_or_format: Package containing two or more individually packaged/labelled units of same food commodity, with identical and/or different net quantity, intended/displayed for retail sale individually or as whole, complying with Regulation 4(8).

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Non-retail containers": Container not intended for direct sale to consumer; food is for further business activities before being offered to consumer.
expected_value_or_format: Container not intended for direct sale to consumer; food is for further business activities before being offered to consumer.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Non-vegetarian food": Food containing whole/part of animal including birds, insects, freshwater/marine animals or eggs/products of animal origin, excluding milk, milk products, honey, bees wax, carnauba wax and shellac.
expected_value_or_format: Food containing whole/part of animal including birds, insects, freshwater/marine animals or eggs/products of animal origin, excluding milk, milk products, honey, bees wax, carnauba wax and shellac.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Package/container": Pre-packed box, bottle, jar, casket, tin, barrel, case, pouch, receptacle, sack, bag, wrapper or similar thing in which food is packed.
expected_value_or_format: Pre-packed box, bottle, jar, casket, tin, barrel, case, pouch, receptacle, sack, bag, wrapper or similar thing in which food is packed.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "RDA": Average daily dietary nutrient intake sufficient for nearly all (97–98%) healthy individuals in a particular life stage and gender group; ICMR values apply, and where unavailable Codex/WHO values apply.
expected_value_or_format: Average daily dietary nutrient intake sufficient for nearly all (97–98%) healthy individuals in a particular life stage and gender group; ICMR values apply, and where unavailable Codex/WHO values apply.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Pre-packaged food": Food placed in a package so contents cannot be changed without tampering and ready for sale to consumer; package means package containing prepackaged food.
expected_value_or_format: Food placed in a package so contents cannot be changed without tampering and ready for sale to consumer; package means package containing prepackaged food.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Principal display panel": Part of container/package intended/likely to be displayed, presented, shown or examined by customer under normal/customary conditions of display, sale or purchase.
expected_value_or_format: Part of container/package intended/likely to be displayed, presented, shown or examined by customer under normal/customary conditions of display, sale or purchase.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Retail pack/unit": Package intended for sale to ultimate consumer for consumption of food contained therein.
expected_value_or_format: Package intended for sale to ultimate consumer for consumption of food contained therein.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Use by/expiry": Date signifying end of estimated period under stated storage conditions after which product may not remain safe/expected quality; food shall not be sold/distributed for human consumption.
expected_value_or_format: Date signifying end of estimated period under stated storage conditions after which product may not remain safe/expected quality; food shall not be sold/distributed for human consumption.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Definition — "Vegetarian food": Any article of food other than Non-Vegetarian Food as defined.
expected_value_or_format: Any article of food other than Non-Vegetarian Food as defined.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Words and expressions not defined in these regulations but defined in the Act, rules or regulations made thereunder have the meanings assigned in those instruments.
expected_value_or_format: Use meanings assigned in the Act/rules/regulations.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: FSSAI may establish an internal mechanism to address problems arising from implementation or interpretation of these regulations.
expected_value_or_format: Internal mechanism may be established.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Every pre-packaged food shall be labelled with information required under these regulations unless otherwise provided.
expected_value_or_format: Required label information.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: For food sold through e-commerce or other direct selling, mandatory label requirements shall be provided to consumer through appropriate means before sale, except batch/lot, best before, use by/expiry and date of manufacture/packing.
expected_value_or_format: Pre-sale online disclosure of mandatory label information except listed date/batch fields.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Pre-packaged food shall not be described/presented in a false, misleading or deceptive manner or in a way likely to create an erroneous impression regarding its character.
expected_value_or_format: No false/misleading/deceptive labelling.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Information or pictorial/graphic matter may be displayed if not in conflict with these regulations.
expected_value_or_format: Additional matter permitted only if non-conflicting.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Required declarations shall be in English or Hindi in Devanagari; other languages may additionally be used provided they do not contradict the English/Hindi information.
expected_value_or_format: English or Hindi required; additional language allowed if non-contradictory.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Label shall be applied so it does not become separated from the container.
expected_value_or_format: Secure label attachment.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Label contents shall be clear, unambiguous, prominent, conspicuous, indelible and readily legible under normal purchase/use conditions.
expected_value_or_format: Legibility attributes.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: If an outside container/wrapper is displayed for retail sale, it shall also contain all declarations required on the package unless it is transparent and package declarations are easily readable; for transparent multi-unit package at least one retail-unit label with required declarations shall be visible.
expected_value_or_format: Outer wrapper/container declaration and visibility condition.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Every package shall carry the name of the food indicating its true nature on the Front of Pack; where identity is established by specified composition, use the name prescribed there; otherwise use common/usual name or description; coined/fanciful/brand/trade name may additionally be used subject to Advertising and Claims Regulation 2018.
expected_value_or_format: True nature name on Front of Pack; specified name where established, otherwise common/usual name or true-nature description; optional coined/fanciful/brand/trade name subject to cited regulation.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Except for single-ingredient foods, the ingredient list shall have an appropriate title such as Ingredients/List of Ingredients.
expected_value_or_format: Ingredient-list heading.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Ingredients shall be listed in descending order of composition by weight or volume at manufacture.
expected_value_or_format: Descending weight/volume order at manufacture.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: A carried-over food additive sufficient to perform a technological function shall be included in the ingredient list.
expected_value_or_format: Include carried-over additive when it performs a technological function.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Ingredients shall use specific names; specified class titles may be used for the 18 classes listed in Regulation 5(2)(d), including oils/fats, starch, fish, meat, cheese, spices/herbs, gum base, dextrose/glucose, sugar, caseinates, cocoa butter, crystallized fruit/vegetable, milk solids, cocoa solids, vitamins and minerals/trace elements.
expected_value_or_format: Use specific ingredient names or permitted class titles exactly as listed in Regulation 5(2)(d) table.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Compound ingredients shall be declared by specific name and either immediately accompanied in brackets by their ingredients in descending proportion, or all compound ingredients shall be declared as individual ingredients of the final food.
expected_value_or_format: Compound ingredient + bracketed descending ingredient list OR individual ingredient declarations.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: If a compound ingredient constitutes less than 5% of the food, ingredients other than food additives serving a technological function need not be declared.
expected_value_or_format: Compound ingredient <5% → non-additive component ingredients may be omitted.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Added water shall be declared except when water forms part of an ingredient such as brine, syrup or broth already declared; evaporated water/volatile ingredients need not be declared.
expected_value_or_format: Declare added water unless source exception applies.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: For dehydrated/condensed foods intended to be reconstituted with water, ingredients in the reconstituted food shall be declared in descending weight/volume and a statement such as “Ingredients of the product when prepared in accordance with the directions on the label” shall be included.
expected_value_or_format: Reconstituted-food ingredient list + preparation-based statement.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Quantitative ingredient declaration shall disclose ingoing percentage by weight/volume where an ingredient is emphasized by words/pictures/graphics, or is not in the name but is essential to characterize the food and omission would mislead/deceive.
expected_value_or_format: Declare ingoing percentage at manufacture for qualifying ingredients.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Quantitative ingredient declaration is not required for flavouring agents (including spices, condiments, herbs/extracts, mixed masalas/seasonings), non-misleading ingredient references in the name, where drained net weight is indicated except emphasized mixed ingredients, where specific provisions apply, pictorial serving suggestions, and added micronutrients subject to nutrition declaration.
expected_value_or_format: Apply listed QUID exceptions.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Nutritional information shall be declared per 100g/100ml or per single consumption pack and per-serve percentage contribution to RDA based on 2000 kcal and specified reference amounts.
applicability: pre-packaged food subject to nutrition labelling
expected_value_or_format: Nutrition information with specified reference basis.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Nutrition declaration shall include energy (kcal), protein, carbohydrate/total sugars/added sugars, total fat/saturated fat/trans fat/cholesterol, and sodium in specified units.
applicability: pre-packaged food subject to nutrition labelling
expected_value_or_format: Required nutrient fields and units as prescribed.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Saturated fat and trans fat may be declared as “not more than”; they are required only if total fat content is more than 0.5% in final food.
expected_value_or_format: Total fat >0.5% → saturated/trans fat declaration; may use “not more than”.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Cholesterol content is required only for products containing fats of animal origin and where total fat content is more than 0.5%.
expected_value_or_format: Animal-origin fat AND total fat >0.5% → cholesterol declaration.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Numerical vitamin/mineral information shall be expressed in metric units; nutrition panel shall show food amount in g/ml beside serving measure and number of servings in package.
expected_value_or_format: Metric units + g/ml serving reference + number of servings.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Serving/serve size means amount customarily consumed per eating occasion or as defined on label, expressed in metric unit; may additionally use household measures such as teaspoon, tablespoon or cup.
expected_value_or_format: Metric serving size; household measure optional.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Foods claimed to be enriched with nutrients such as minerals, proteins, vitamins, amino acids or enzymes shall give quantities of added nutrients on label.
expected_value_or_format: Declare quantity of added nutrient.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: The foods listed in Regulation 5(3)(c)(i)-(xiii) are exempt from mandatory nutritional labelling, subject to the stated conditions.
expected_value_or_format: Apply the complete exemption list in Regulation 5(3)(c).

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Packages of edible oils, interesterified vegetable fat, hydrogenated/partially hydrogenated oils, edible fats, margarine, fat spreads, and foods in which fats/oils/fat emulsions are ingredients shall declare trans fat and saturated fat; these may be stated as “not more than”.
applicability: specified oils/fats and foods containing fats/oils/emulsions
expected_value_or_format: Trans fat + saturated fat declaration.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Specified edible oils/fats/fat spreads shall additionally declare monounsaturated, polyunsaturated, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acid quantities; nutrition information is required if a nutrition or health claim is made.
expected_value_or_format: Declare MUFA, PUFA, omega-3, omega-6; nutrition panel if claim made.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Declared nutrient quantities have a maximum minus 10% tolerance at any point during declared shelf life.
expected_value_or_format: Actual nutrient value must not be below declared value by more than 10%.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Energy shall be calculated using conversion factors: carbohydrate 4 kcal/g; polyols except erythritol 2; erythritol 0; protein 4; fat 9; ethanol 7; organic acid 3; dietary fibre 2.
expected_value_or_format: Specified kcal/g conversion factors.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Protein shall be calculated as Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen × 6.25 unless another scientifically justified factor is used; milk uses factor 6.38.
expected_value_or_format: Protein = TKN × 6.25; milk factor 6.38.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Nutritional information may additionally be provided as Barcode/Global Trade Identification Number (GTIN).
expected_value_or_format: GTIN/barcode may additionally provide nutritional information.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Every package of non-vegetarian food containing animal-origin ingredients, additives or processing aids shall bear the prescribed brown filled-triangle-in-square symbol; an egg-only non-vegetarian ingredient may additionally be declared.
expected_value_or_format: Brown triangle symbol in square; optional egg-only declaration.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Every package of vegetarian food containing plant-origin ingredients, additives or processing aids shall bear the prescribed green filled-circle-in-square symbol.
expected_value_or_format: Green circle symbol in square.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Vegetarian/non-vegetarian logo minimum sizes depend on principal display panel area: up to 100 cm² (circle 3mm, triangle 2.5mm, square 6mm); >100–500 (4,3.5,8); >500–2500 (6,5,12); >2500 (8,7,16).
expected_value_or_format: Use prescribed logo-size table.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Veg/non-veg declaration shall also be prominently displayed on pamphlets, leaflets and advertisements; symbol shall be on contrasting background on principal display panel close to product name/brand name on front of pack.
expected_value_or_format: Prominent declaration and placement.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Veg/non-veg provisions do not apply to mineral water, packaged drinking water, carbonated water, alcoholic beverages, liquid milk, milk powders and honey.
expected_value_or_format: Exempt categories listed in Regulation 5(4).

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Functional class of food additives shall be declared together with specific name(s) or recognized INS number in ingredient list.
expected_value_or_format: Functional class + specific name or INS.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Where flavouring agent is added under cited Regulation 3.3.1(1), artificial flavouring uses common flavour name; natural/nature-identical flavouring uses class name.
expected_value_or_format: Artificial: common flavour name; natural/nature-identical: class name.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Brand owner name and complete address shall be declared with the prescribed qualifying words; alcoholic beverages may use specified bottled/blended/imported/distilled wording.
expected_value_or_format: Brand owner name/address + qualifying wording.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Imported food shall carry importer name and complete address; food manufactured outside India but packaged/bottled in India shall also bear country of origin, importer details and Indian packing/bottling premises.
expected_value_or_format: Importer and, where applicable, country of origin and Indian packing/bottling details.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: FSSAI logo and licence number shall be displayed on the food package in contrast colour.
expected_value_or_format: FSSAI logo + licence number.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Brand owner's FSSAI logo/licence number shall be displayed; if manufacturer/marketer/packer/bottler differs, that party's licence number shall also be displayed.
expected_value_or_format: Brand owner licence + different operator licence where applicable.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Imported food products shall display FSSAI logo/licence number with importer name/address.
expected_value_or_format: FSSAI logo/licence + importer name/address.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: FBO premises where food is stored, processed, distributed or sold shall prominently display Registration/Licence No. or Food Safety Display Board if specified, plus other information specified by Food Authority.
expected_value_or_format: Prominent premises display.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Fortified and organic food shall carry the logo specified in Schedule I; FSSAI may specify logos for other foods.
expected_value_or_format: Schedule I logo; additional FSSAI-specified logos where applicable.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Net quantity, Retail Sale Price and Consumer Care details shall follow the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and rules made thereunder.
expected_value_or_format: LM Act/rules declarations.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Batch/code/lot number shall be declared on the label.
expected_value_or_format: Batch/code/lot number.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Date of manufacture/packaging and Expiry/Use by shall be declared; Best before may be optional/additional.
expected_value_or_format: Date of manufacture/packaging + Expiry/Use by; Best before optional/additional.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: For shelf life up to 3 months, date is DD/MM/YY; for shelf life >3 months, month and year in un-coded numerical sequence with month in capital letters/at least first three-letter abbreviation; DD/MM/YY is also permitted for >3 months.
expected_value_or_format: Date format by shelf-life band.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: If expiry/use-by validity depends on storage conditions, those special conditions shall be declared; storage conditions after opening may also be specified.
expected_value_or_format: Relevant storage conditions.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Expiry indication is not required for fresh fruits/vegetables including unpeeled potatoes, all wine, alcoholic beverages >=10% v/v, vinegar, sugar boiled confectionery, food-grade salt for industrial use, solid sugars, and chewing gum/bubble gum.
expected_value_or_format: Apply listed expiry exemptions.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Date of manufacture/packaging and Expiry/Use by shall be grouped together at one place.
expected_value_or_format: Grouped date declarations.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Packed meals served in airlines/railways/mobile catering units shall declare date and time of manufacture.
applicability: packed meals in specified catering units
expected_value_or_format: Date and time of manufacture.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

description: Imported-food labelling is additionally governed by Food Safety and Standards (Import) Regulations, 2017.
expected_value_or_format: Apply cited Import Regulations in addition.

legal_reference.source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Version VIII (09.09.2025)

expected_value_or_format: Locality/hamlet/specified place may not form part of trade name unless it refers to packaged water collected at the designated place.

description: Schedule II requires the specified declaration/restriction for Packaged/mineral drinking water — misleading statements/devices.
expected_value_or_format: No statement/pictorial device that may confuse or mislead about nature, origin, composition or properties.

description: Schedule II requires the specified declaration/restriction for Gluten Free product.
expected_value_or_format: “Gluten Free” shall be printed in immediate proximity to product name for products described in cited Regulation 2.14; if made in plant also producing gluten-containing products, label “Processed in a plant where gluten containing products are manufactured”.
